theConstraintThatShapesThis: Zero RASTER_PASS families lack an independent-verification claim, so no second read is mintable and every one needs claim.mjs --transfer. Provisioning eight cloud verification lanes would have produced three assignments that cannot be claimed.

duplicateBytes.heldOutOfVerification: families sharing bytes are excluded from second-read assignment until PF-B classifies whether identical bytes across distinct statutory routes is a defect; one read over twelve families is not twelve verdicts
